messages.subject: Question about how to plot 101 trees in one picture
parts:
Hi, 
thank you for your help and looking my question. My tree file format is NEXUS, which contains 101 trees. I want to plot them in one picture to see their similarity or difference. 
I used this command: but it doesn't work.
tree<-read.nexus(file.choose(),force.multi = T)    (note: attachment is my tree file)
ggtree(tree)+facet_wrap(~.id,ncol=10). 
I guess it maybe the facet classification name is wrong, but I don't know how to check my tree file parameter names. So how can I definite my facet_wrap facets name?
Thank you again for the help!
Kind regards,
Xu Xiao
